translations.web: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
translations.bsb: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
translations.kjv: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
translations.asv: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever. Psalm 29 A Psalm of David.
